thread:
tara: FYI we had a set of models where the onboard bench passed but customers saw garbled punctuation on short messages after quantization. thinking we need a targeted "edge-tokenizer" phase in onboarding.

ben: yeah this pattern keeps popping up w/ models that use custom special tokens. the exporter sometimes remaps unknowns.

bench-bot: proposal: add a 3-check lightweight job after bench: (A) special-token parity (confirm special tokens map to same ids), (B) zero-shot short-prompt alignment (N=40 short prompts), (C) punctuation/emoji fidelity check.

jess: for (B) we should use tokenized-delta rather than raw text diff. text diffs can be misleading due to sampling.

bench-bot: agreed. tokenized-delta rules: normalize unicode (NFKC), remove trailing whitespace, collapse repeated punctuation to single token for comparison tolerance. flag if token-shift > 2.

tara: what about quant-only failures? block or tag?

jess: tag as "no-quant" / restricted and auto-open remediation ticket with suggested fixes (re-export with per-channel scales, different quant scheme). allow manual override.

ops_bot: console change: expose badge and a one-click rerun converter with alternate params. also show the tokenized diff inline for quicker triage.

ben: runtime cost? bench-bot: about 90s per model if we reuse warmed containers, parallelizable. storage impact negligible as we only keep diffs for 7 days.

jess: add canary option: if restricted but team requests quant, allow 0.5% traffic to quant path for 24h with extra logging. auto rollback on error spikes.

tara: implementation plan: (1) bench-bot job + canonical serializer script, (2) pipeline stage named "edge-tokenizer-check", (3) console badge + rerun, (4) docs + remediation templates.

ben: I'll prototype serializer and token-diff util. ping me if you want to pair.

bench-bot: tagging notes: need list of special tokens per model and a tiny golden prompt set focusing on punctuation/emoji and short fragments.

ops_bot: i'll draft UX copy for the badge and ticket actions.

tara: thanks all. i'll open the RFC follow-up PR and add thresholds. posting summary to #eng-ml in a few minutes. :rocket:
